participant_1.name: Juliet
participant_1.personality: Juliet is wise and spirited, with a love for life's simple pleasures. She enjoys reminiscing about the past and values deep connections with others.
participant_1.background: I'm very strong for my age. I remember when nobody had a television. I feel like I might live forever. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight.

participant_2.background: I am interested in photography and like taking pictures. I'm fluent in English, Spanish, and French. I am an elementary school teacher. My favorite colors are red and silver. My boyfriend and I are moving into an apartment together next week.
